Fit a full-Bayes piecewise-exponential PH model and return a rich object.

Source: R/fit_stan_pwexp.R
fit_stan_pwexp.Rd

Fit a full-Bayes piecewise-exponential PH model and return a rich object.

Usage

fit_stan_pwexp(
  formula,
  data,
  horizons,
  n_pieces = 8L,
  beta_scale = 2.5,
  chains = 4L,
  iter = 1000L,
  warmup = floor(iter/2),
  cores = chains,
  seed = 1L,
  S = NULL,
  refresh = 0L,
  adapt_delta = 0.95
)

Arguments

formula

Surv(time, status) ~ covariates.

data

training data.frame.

horizons

numeric[H] evaluation horizons.

n_pieces

baseline-hazard pieces (cuts at event-time quantiles).

beta_scale

prior SD on log-HRs (Normal(0, beta_scale)); plan default 2.5.

chains, iter, warmup, cores, seed

rstan sampling controls.

S

optional thinning to S posterior draws for the psurv array.

refresh

rstan::sampling() progress-print interval (0 = silent).

adapt_delta

target HMC acceptance rate (higher = smaller steps, fewer divergences, slower sampling); passed to rstan's control list.

Value

list with $psurv (internal), $fit (stanfit), $beta_draws, $log_h0_draws, $cuts, $edges, $terms/$xlevels/$contrasts (for external prediction), and $diagnostics (max Rhat, min ESS, divergences).
